cat > /tmp/work/test.py <<'EOF'
import json,re,random,chess,sys
R=json.load(open("/tmp/obench-cell-6n8ay3w9/bench_opencode_regex-chess_w9e5h4fo/re.json"))
def run(fen):
    for p,r in R: fen=re.sub(p,r,fen)
    return fen.split("\n")
ex="<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print(run(ex)==["<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0","<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0","<REDACTED_B64> b kq - 0 0"])
def verify(fen):
    ours=[" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    b=chess.Board(fen); exp=set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion!=chess.QUEEN: continue
        c=b.copy(); c.push(m); exp.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    ok=len(ours)==len(exp) and len(set(ours))==len(ours) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL",fen); print(sorted(ours)); print(sorted(exp)); sys.exit(1)
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
n=0
for g in range(400):
    b=chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply()<300:
        if b.turn==chess.WHITE: verify(b.fen()); n+=1
        ms=list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias toward captures/promotions/castling
        pref=[m for m in ms if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(pref) if pref and random.random()<0.7 else random.choice(ms))
print("ok",n)
EOF
time python3 /tmp/work/test.py 1
